fix_commit.message: Try to fix reported qlog issues
fix_commit.author: Bernd Edlinger

findings.title: Infinite loop when frame header parsing fails in qlog
findings.message: The log_frame() function returns 0 when ossl_quic_wire_peek_frame_header() fails without setting the *need_skip output parameter. The calling loop in log_frames() iterates while PACKET_remaining(&pkt) > 0, and relies on either (a) successful frame parsing which advances the packet position, or (b) need_skip being set to skip bytes. When peek_frame_header fails, neither condition is met: the packet position is not advanced and need_skip remains 0. This causes the loop to infinitely call log_frame() on the same packet position, resulting in an infinite loop that causes CI test failures and potential denial of service.

related_locations.description: The while loop that calls log_frame and becomes infinite when log_frame returns 0 without setting need_skip
The call site where log_frame failure leads to goto cont without advancing packet

findings.suggestion: When ossl_quic_wire_peek_frame_header() fails, set *need_skip = SIZE_MAX before returning 0 to ensure the calling loop skips the remaining packet data and terminates.

ground_truth.root_cause: Missing error handling in log_frame() when peek_frame_header fails. The function returns failure (0) but does not set the need_skip output parameter, which the caller uses to determine how many bytes to skip. Without this, the caller loop never terminates because PACKET_remaining() continues to return a positive value.
